Game Overview

Pengu Pengu puts players into a animal experience centered on embark on an icy adventure with Pengu. Navigate treacherous landscapes, dodge cunning traps, and outsmart polar bears. Collect every fish to ensure your penguin family’s survival. With each fish gathered, the challenge intensifies. Can you safely guide Pengu to the mother penguin and her precious egg? Brace yourself for snowbound excitement!

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Pengu Pengu is easy to pick up. Embark on an icy adventure with Pengu! Navigate treacherous landscapes, dodge cunning traps, and outsmart polar bears.
